notes:
Account background: StonePoint IteraTech is building an embedded AI assistant in their B2B workflow product for mid-sized enterprises (finance and operations verticals). They signed up for hosted API trial in Jan 2026; traction from internal pilot (20 power users).

Conversation snapshot:
- 2026-02-18 demo: product team liked streaming and function-calling; asked about session affinity and KV cache for user state. Quote from PM: 'We need <200ms median for agent interactions or it's too slow for workflows.'
- Interest pattern: start on Hosted API (fast time-to-value), move to Dedicated for predictability if unit economics and latency SLOs check out.

Technical priorities and constraints:
- Primary workloads: multi-turn chat (agent), semantic search over customer docs (~10M docs), reranking for suggestions.
- Latency SLOs: median chat <200ms token-response, p95 <450ms; search queries ~120ms average for top-k embedding retrieval (cache hot-path).
- Throughput: expected steady-state 80–150 chat reqs/sec during business hours; batch offline embedding jobs 200–500 reqs/min for nightly enrichment.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — wants to keep monthly inference spend under $15k during first 6 months of rollout.

Security/compliance:
- Requires SSO/SAML integration, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS for key management. Legal flagged EU data residency for certain customer records (must confirm Redwood region/euro data plane).

POC status:
- Hosted API POC in progress using small redwood model variant (rwd-small-v1) for agent flows. Initial smoke tests show 15–20% higher token latency vs expected in docs (likely due to session churn and no prefix caching).
- SE ran micro-benchmark (embeddings + rerank) — cost per 1k queries estimated at $9.2 hosted vs $3.8 projected on Dedicated with moderate quantization and batching (rough sketch). Need formal workshop to validate assumptions.

unit_economics_summary: Workshop goals: build a conservative unit-cost model for chat + search. Baseline hosted run-rate shows $0.055/token for agent flow at small model. Opportunity: batching + prefix caching + int8 quantization on Dedicated could reduce unit cost by 40–65% depending on throughput. Key levers: increase avg batch size from 1.4 -> 6 for synchronous search workloads; activate KV/prefix caching for recurrent user prompts (expected 20-30% token avoid). Quantization tradeoffs: int8 safe for reranking/embeddings, 4-bit (q4) may need evals for chat quality. Need A/B prompt tests for quality delta.
